acceptance_criteria: Freeze is sole first branch file and externally anchored before implementation.
Weights are derived only from sigma_servo, sigma_cavendish, and kappa.
Aggregate enclosure is constructed before comparison-only terminal target is read by the classification stage.
Source attestation pins exact transcribed values and locators.
Focused tests and bounded mutation family pass.
One complete Python suite and relevant guards pass on final tree.
git diff --check is clean when local environment permits; otherwise exact-head CI is authoritative repository-wide gate.
PR requires a true merge commit to preserve freeze/anchor chronology.

classification.compatible: the exact aggregate enclosure has non-empty intersection with the published combined central-value cell
classification.incompatible: the exact aggregate enclosure is disjoint from the published combined central-value cell
classification.unresolved: reserved for invalid/degenerate estimator geometry or a future bounded-search extension; no such case is expected for a valid positive-definite 2x2 covariance summary

correction_provenance.role: corroborates that the 2014 corrected analysis supersedes numerical aspects of the 2013 PRL result

focused_tests: exact minimum-variance weight derivation and weight sum
exact input-cell construction and sign-aware aggregate enclosure
synthetic compatible and incompatible terminal cells

known_prior_information.allowed_claim: The estimator structure and derived weights must be functions only of the frozen method uncertainties and covariance; the published combined central value is comparison-only.
known_prior_information.reason: The candidate-selection discussion before this freeze already exposed the paper's reported combined value, printed weights, and covariance summary. This PR therefore claims target-independent implementation, not outcome blindness.

aggregate_enclosure.kind: exact sign-aware linear image of the Cartesian product of the two input cells under the derived frozen weights

input_representation.rationale: The printed method central values are finite-resolution summaries; no hidden unrounded values are claimed.

terminal_representation.kind: closed decimal rounding-consistency cell for equation (12.2)

mutation_requirements: leak published combined central value into weights
collapse one input cell to its midpoint
nonclaims: No new laboratory measurement of G.
No independent validation of the BIPM apparatus or uncertainty budget.
No claim that the displayed method central values equal hidden unrounded author values.
No probability model beyond the source-declared covariance/variance use in the minimum-variance linear estimator.
No cross-publication common-constant inference or universality claim.
objective: Reconstruct the corrected BIPM 2014 two-method weighted estimator from the two published method values and the published 2x2 uncertainty/covariance summary, with estimator weights determined without using the published combined central value.

primary_source.journal: Philosophical Transactions of the Royal Society A
primary_source.publication: T. Quinn, C. Speake, H. Parks, R. Davis, The BIPM measurements of the Newtonian constant of gravitation, G

scientific_constraints: Use exact rational/decimal arithmetic for weights, interval endpoints, and central-value enclosure.
Require the 2x2 covariance matrix to be positive definite: sigma_servo>0, sigma_cavendish>0, sigma_servo^2*sigma_cavendish^2-kappa^2>0.
Do not assume the paper's printed 0.46/0.54 weights are exact estimator inputs.
Do not reconstruct raw torque runs or apparatus-level G values in this PR.
Do not use HUST artifacts or cross the E-001 evidence-classification boundary.
Do not modify frozen HUST, Schlamminger, Newman, or PR #41 artifacts.

invariance_tests: changing comparison-only combined central value cannot change derived weights or aggregate enclosure
changing comparison-only printed weights cannot change derived weights
changing comparison-only combined uncertainty cannot change derived weights or aggregate enclosure
required_order: load and validate method values plus sigma_servo, sigma_cavendish, kappa
derive covariance diagnostics and minimum-variance unbiased weights
construct input cells and aggregate enclosure
only then expose comparison-only printed weights/combined uncertainty/combined central value
